purpose: Frozen question/answer pairs for the M5 Phase 2 agent comparison between the real DSH default retrieval tools and the code-intelligence context_* tools. Deterministically derived from the frozen gold; contains no tool-specific tuning.

rules.questions: Every arm receives the byte-identical question text; the task set is frozen before any arm runs.
rules.answers: Grading is programmatic against answerSpec: exact string equality for text and path, exact integer equality for lines, order-independent set equality for path/name/target sets (compared after trimming and de-duplication).
rules.leakage: No question names a tool, a tool argument, or a retrieval strategy. The gold request fields (name/kind/mode/offsets/lineRange/types) are restated because they define the task, not the method.
rules.independence: This file and its generator never call the tested extractor or any tool; they only project eval/m5/gold.json.
rules.scope: This is a retrieval QA benchmark over a frozen corpus, not a SWE task benchmark. It measures whether an agent can obtain and report repository facts, not whether it can change code.

budget.note: Identical caps for every arm. An arm that exceeds a cap fails that task.
